importance_ranking.reason: High visual variation between sub-types — fabric canopy carport, metal panel enclosed garage, foldable structure, and dome-top variants are visually distinct. Buyers use the listing image to identify product type and size (single vs double car) before reading any text; wrong type is an immediate skip.

Vehicle capacity, cover material, and frame material are primary shortlisting criteria — a buyer needing a 2-car metal panel structure cannot substitute a 1-car fabric canopy. Without these specs, the listing cannot be evaluated for fit.

Residential and small commercial buyers compare per-piece prices aggressively across multiple sellers after confirming product type match. India price sensitivity is high; price is a decisive shortlisting lever in this commoditised mid-market segment.

importance_ranking.brand_important_reason: No established Indian brands with buyer recall exist in this category; market is fragmented across regional fabricators and importers with no brand-name search behaviour observed.
importance_ranking.reason: Seller credibility, installation support, and track record matter to buyers making a considered purchase, but no dominant brands exist — buyers evaluate company after specs and price confirm fit.

importance_ranking.unit_note: Fabricated/modular variants are quoted per sq ft, but the dominant primary segment (fabric canopy kit) is always sold per piece/set. No buyer confusion arises for kit-form products.
importance_ranking.reason: Kit-form portable garages are universally sold per piece or per set; no buyer ever questions this unit. Per sq ft applies only to custom-fabricated modular variants outside the primary segment.

top_configurator_specs.reason: Defines the structural form of the product (Canopy Type vs Enclosed Garage vs Wall Attached vs Standalone) — non-interchangeable across buyer needs and carries a 3–5x price delta between canopy and enclosed garage variants.
Determines the physical size of the structure (1 Car vs 2 Car vs 4 Car) — non-interchangeable and drives significant price delta between single and multi-vehicle configurations.

missing_important_specs.why_important: Residential buyers must confirm the structure's footprint (length × width × height) fits their available parking space before purchase — sellers need this to confirm standard sizes are adequate or quote custom fabrication.

top_rfq_specs.reason: Directly determines the physical size of the structure a seller must supply — a seller with only 1-car units cannot respond to a 2-car or SUV requirement, making this the primary routing spec.
Determines product type and quality tier — sellers specialising in fabric canopy kits cannot supply metal sheet structures, making this the primary seller-type routing signal after capacity.

missing_important_specs.why_important: Sellers need the required footprint to confirm whether standard sizes fit the buyer's space or whether custom fabrication is needed — without this, sellers cannot respond with accurate availability or pricing.
Sellers specialising in foldable/portable units cannot supply fixed semi-permanent structures — this spec routes the RFQ to the correct seller type when not already implied by covering material.
